author: Unreal Sensei
description:
The ultimate landscape and terrain creator for UE5! Learn how to use the new Mesh Terrain system to create complex next generation landscapes in Unreal Engine. Introducing the Sensei Terrain Master Material which is the first master material for Mesh Terrain. Features include Nanite displacement, auto texturing, virtual texture blending, triplanar projection and more.
